## About
Metal and Paint is an auto body and collision shop on Arcado Road in Lilburn, run by co-owners Anas Attrah, who most folks call A.T., and Ammar Atrah. We opened with a shared love for cars and a simple goal: put every vehicle back the way it should be, in how it looks and how it drives.
We handle collision repair, dent and scratch removal, painting, bumper repair and restorations. When insurance is involved, we work directly with most major providers so you can focus on getting back on the road.
Drivers have given us a 4.9 rating from 245 Google reviews. If something's going on with your car, give us a call and tell us what happened. We'll do our best to help.

## Services
- Collision repair: From minor impacts to serious structural damage, including frame straightening, panel replacement, unibody repair and post-repair diagnostics.
- Paintless dent repair: Door dings, creases and hail damage, fixed without paint where possible to keep your original finish.
- Paint and finish: Computerized color matching for spot blending, full-body repainting and clear coat protection, plus custom paint jobs on request.
- Cracked or dented bumpers: Bumpers and other plastic parts repaired, often without needing a full replacement.
- Insurance paperwork: Direct billing to insurers, digital photo estimates, repair authorization support and total loss guidance.
- Restoration: Full body restoration, rust repair, panel fabrication and custom upgrades for classic or damaged vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance?
A: We work directly with most major insurance providers, with direct billing, digital photo estimates and help with repair authorization. We're also a State Farm Select Service shop.

Q: What does being a State Farm Select Service shop mean for me?
A: If you're with State Farm, we deal with them directly, estimates and approvals move faster, and you get a guaranteed completion date for your repair.

Q: Do you do custom paint jobs?
A: Yes, custom paint work is available on request. Give us a call and tell us what you have in mind.
